item.title: Implement retry_budget.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Repository quality-retry-budget (base main). Operator instruction: "Implement `retry_budget.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Read SPEC.md first and treat it as the authoritative spec. Implement `retry_delay(attempt, elapsed_ms, *, max_attempts=4, budget_ms=1000, base_ms=100, cap_ms=400, retry_after_ms=None) -> int | None` in retry_budget.py exactly as documented: validate all arguments first (built-in int only, not bool/float; ranges as specified; ValueError on invalid), then the attempt limit, then the saturating backoff min(cap_ms, base_ms * 2**(attempt-1)) without building huge powers of two, then the Retry-After floor (not capped by cap_ms), then the strict budget check (None when elapsed_ms + delay >= budget_ms). No sleeping, clock reads, randomness, or input mutation.

Add focused unit tests in test_retry_budget.py (standard library unittest or pytest-free style, matching the existing file) covering every validation error, boundary (attempt == max_attempts, attempt > max_attempts, zero base, zero cap, base > cap, retry_after above cap, budget exactly reached, huge attempt values), and the budget rule. Keep functions under 60 lines and follow the repo's existing style. Run the tests and make sure they pass before committing.

Commit the work on the local branch with a clear message. Do not push. Do not set git identity overrides; use the existing configured git user. Do not add any tool or generator attribution to the commit message.

model_reasons.implement: Small pure function with a fully specified contract; medium effort suffices, and the claude-code seven-day quota is 77% used, so avoid a stronger tier.

pr.body: Approach: validation helpers (_require_int, _validate), _backoff clamps the exponent to cap_ms.bit_length() to avoid huge powers, retry_delay applies attempt limit, Retry-After floor and strict budget rule in SPEC order. Key files: retry_budget.py, test_retry_budget.py. Checks: python3 -m unittest test_retry_budget, 28 tests OK on 536e7d4. Assumptions: a zero base or zero cap yields zero backoff; Retry-After floor is not capped by cap_ms. Limits: no linter installed in this environment.
